description: A beige Alterra 300 ATV lost traction on a snowbank — discovered mid-EVA that this model has no 4WD, unlike the olive Arctic Cat 450s.
response: The vehicle detoured while a 4WD Arctic Cat scaled the bank. Mission objectives were achieved.
lesson: Know your fleet before EVAs. Arctic Cat 450s = 4WD; Alterra 300s = 2WD only. Mark each ATV visibly. Never assign a 300 as lead vehicle on technical terrain.
